transport: persistent child process; UTF-8 JSONL stdin/stdout
tts_output: mono PCM16 WAV, explicit actual sample_rate; do not label ready time as audible time
security: spool-relative paths only; no external URLs; no traversal/symlink escape; no shell interpolation
asr_partial_policy: display only, never scoring or LLM prompt
confidence_policy: null unless actually supplied and meaning documented
note: Protocol specification, not a working speech model.
